<%# REQ: LANG-941 LANG-942 LANG-943 LANG-944 %> <!DOCTYPE html> <html> <body> <h1><%= @page.title.upcase %></h1> <% if @items.any? %> <ul> <% @items.each_with_index do |item, i| %> <li class="<%= i.even? ? "even" : "odd" %>"><%= link_to item.name, item_path(item) %></li> <% end %> </ul> <% else %> <p>No items, :none</p> <%- end -%> <%# A comment that is not rendered %> <p>Total: <%= number_with_delimiter(1_000 * 3) %></p> </body> </html>
